sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual airborne microbial sample record.

city_name.descr: Name of the city where the sample was collected.

country_name.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

collection_site_name.descr: Local site name or label for the sampling location (e.g., park entrance, street intersection, rooftop).

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling location above sea level in meters.

collection_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

collection_time_local.descr: Local time of day when the sample was collected (HH:MM:SS).

timezone.descr: Time zone of the sampling location at collection time (e.g., UTC+1, America/New_York).

weather_condition.descr: General weather condition at sampling time (e.g., clear, cloudy, rainy, foggy).

temperature_c.descr: Air temperature at sampling time in degrees Celsius (°C).

relative_humidity_pct.descr: Relative humidity at sampling time as a percentage (0-100).

wind_speed_m_s.descr: Wind speed at sampling time in meters per second (m/s).

wind_direction_deg.descr: Wind direction at sampling time in degrees from north (0-360).

air_quality_index.descr: Air Quality Index measured at or nearest to the sampling time, using the local or national AQI scale used by the city/region.

pm25_ug_m3.descr: Fine particulate matter concentration (PM2.5) in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m³) at sampling time.

pm10_ug_m3.descr: Particulate matter concentration (PM10) in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m³) at sampling time.

ozone_ppb.descr: Ozone concentration at sampling time in parts per billion (ppb).

nitrogen_dioxide_ppb.descr: Nitrogen dioxide concentration at sampling time in parts per billion (ppb).

proximity_to_industrial_area_m.descr: Approximate distance from the sampling location to the nearest industrial area in meters.

proximity_to_green_space_m.descr: Approximate distance from the sampling location to the nearest green space or park in meters.

environment_type.descr: Dominant surrounding environment category at the sampling site (e.g., residential, commercial, industrial, park, roadside, mixed-use).

sample_height_m.descr: Height above ground at which the airborne microbial sample was collected in meters.

sampling_method.descr: Method used to collect airborne microbial material (e.g., filter, impaction, cyclone).

sequencing_platform.descr: Genomic sequencing platform used to generate the data (e.g., Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, Oxford Nanopore).

sequencing_target.descr: Targeted genomic region or assay type used for microbial characterization (e.g., 16S rRNA, ITS, shotgun metagenomics).

microbial_community_context.descr: Free-text or standardized notes on the sampled airborne microbial community context, if relevant to interpretation.
